limitations: The pre-compact D45 comparison is exploratory and does not qualify the compact-storage candidate.
D45 used the source .ppmap catalog directly; its application-cold results do not establish isolated package-catalog cold behavior.
Both comparisons use deterministic paired order and do not flush the OS file cache; P99 is the maximum of 20 observations.
All ready timings end at the first successful actual present after eight live players; they do not wait for optional HD texture promotion or physical display scanout.
Allocated-byte telemetry is an approximate process-wide GC counter delta; process CPU is process-wide CPU-time delta; peak working set is a process-lifetime high-water mark sampled at readiness.
The Linux runtime smoke used software rendering; Android checks ran on a headless CPU emulator and do not establish physical GPU or lifecycle memory-pressure behavior.
The service transfer fixture is synthetic and local; it is not a valid package archive or public-network throughput measurement.

The attempted GL frame capture is unsupported because MapAudit bypasses renderer profiler hooks. The separate existing CPU -perfcheck completed at 1920x1080, but measures no frame pacing or GPU execution time; required hosted CI remains a separate merge gate.
No CDN enablement, live deployment, or production write was performed.
